admission_and_stop_conditions: Freeze an exact hypothesis, manifest, deterministic TA-Lib-parity runner, costs, windows and all-pass gate set before opening any KAMA outcome.

Run only complete-day close above exact KAMA30 with KAMA20 and KAMA40 as rejection-only neighbors. Do not run another efficiency period, fast or slow constant, price source, slope, crossover, confirmation, stop, short, leverage, DRA interaction or ensemble.

Require positive normal and stress returns, materially better Validation drawdown and Calmar, frozen upside capture, annual breadth, bounded turnover and holding, low episode and year concentration and no terminal-inventory uplift; otherwise permanently close the exact family.
Any ambiguity in TA-Lib initialization, unstable-period handling, zero-volatility efficiency ratio or next-open availability returns evidence insufficient without outcome access.
A positive historical result may create at most one REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED candidate and one independent sealed OOS gate; it authorizes no Trading action.
causal_hypothesis: Kaufman's efficiency-ratio-controlled smoothing accelerates when completed-day BTC closes move directionally with little path noise and decelerates in choppy paths, so close above the adaptive line may retain efficient trends while reducing fixed-average whipsaw before the next hourly fill.
claim_boundary: This prior makes one exact default KAMA30 price-state family preregistration-ready only. It establishes formula identity, an executable free data path and strong adverse evidence, not alpha, a candidate, OOS value, deployability or Trading authority.
economic_hypothesis: A full-capital BTC long-or-zero-yield-cash policy using completed-day close strictly above TA-Lib-default KAMA30 may improve fee- and slippage-adjusted drawdown and Calmar versus matched buy-and-hold only if it retains frozen upside, annual breadth and adjacent 20/40-period stability.

frozen_pre_outcome_contract.neighbor_rationale: The nearest round ten-day efficiency windows around the official default are frozen before outcome access solely to reject a period-fragile primary; neither neighbor may replace it.

independence_assessment.not_dra_path_efficiency: The closed DRA intraday path-efficiency family used one-day H1 path efficiency as an entry admission for a lot-based parent. KAMA uses a 30-complete-day close path only to vary a standalone full-capital trend line.
independence_assessment.not_fixed_sma: The closed SMA150/200/250 family uses an equal-weight fixed lookback. KAMA30 uses a recursive line whose per-day smoothing coefficient changes with the ratio of net 30-day displacement to cumulative absolute daily movement.
independence_assessment.not_macd: The closed MACD family compares fixed-fast and fixed-slow EMAs and a separate EMA signal. This family compares price with one efficiency-adaptive recursive level and has no EMA-spread signal line.
independence_assessment.not_supertrend_or_donchian: KAMA has no ATR band, ratcheting stop or rolling extreme breakout. Its state can change without crossing an ATR or high-low channel.
independence_assessment.residual_risk: KAMA remains economically adjacent to the already weak trend-following cluster. Mathematical distinction and adaptive smoothing do not establish independent alpha, so the prior confidence is low and the family receives only one frozen screen.

missing_proof: No peer-reviewed primary source establishes standalone BTC close-above-default-KAMA30 economic value; direct BTC evidence located is adverse and non-peer-reviewed.
No schema-valid hypothesis, manifest or deterministic TA-Lib-parity KAMA runner is frozen yet.

No KAMA feature support, matched-capital Design or Validation economics, fees, slippage, realized or unrealized PnL, drawdown, Calmar, holding, inventory, breadth, concentration, candidate, OOS or forward evidence has been observed.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The official function defines KAMA as a prior KAMA plus a squared efficiency-ratio-scaled smoothing coefficient times the price gap. Its default efficiency-ratio period is 30, with fast and slow constants corresponding to 2 and 30 periods.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: TA-Lib Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average function and Core C implementation
primary_prior_matrix.parameter_boundary: This fixes exact TA-Lib behavior and KAMA30 as the sole primary. It supplies no BTC economic evidence and no permission to alter initialization, constants, period, price source or equality after outcome access.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The original KAMA identity, as cited by the official implementation, uses the ratio of directional price change to total path movement to adapt smoothing between a fast and slow response.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Perry J. Kaufman, Smarter Trading: Improving Performance in Changing Markets, McGraw-Hill, 1995
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Indicator identity does not establish that price above KAMA predicts BTC returns or beats matched buy-and-hold after costs.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The study reports time variation in cryptocurrency market efficiency, consistent with an adaptive-market interpretation rather than constant predictability.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Chu, Zhang and Chan, The adaptive market hypothesis in the high frequency cryptocurrency market, International Review of Financial Analysis 64, 2019, DOI 10.1016/j.irfa.2019.05.008
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Time-varying efficiency is not evidence that KAMA30 is tradable. It instead requires fixed parameters, separated Design and Validation windows, annual breadth and independent OOS before any value claim.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The BTC KAMA study reports Reality Check p-values near one across its validation procedures and does not reject the null of no real edge.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Mariani, Analysis of an Algo Trading Strategy Based on the Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average and Statistical Validation Using Bootstrap and Bayesian Optimization, SSRN 5694583, 2025
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The study is a recent non-peer-reviewed working paper and tests a different optimized strategy, but its negative finding is strong reason to allow only one official-default frozen screen and prohibit optimization.

primary_prior_matrix.finding: The broad technical-rule study reports no Bitcoin predictability in its out-of-sample period despite wider in-sample and cross-crypto findings.
primary_prior_matrix.identity: Hudson and Urquhart, Technical trading and cryptocurrencies, Annals of Operations Research 297, 2021, DOI 10.1007/s10479-019-03357-1
primary_prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: One adaptive-average screen may be evaluated, but failure closes the exact family and a historical pass still requires independent sealed OOS.
